abstract: A 30-year-old man was diagnosed with testicular cancer, and underwent a radical orchiectomy. Pathological diagnosis was a mixed type nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. We diagnosed him as having stage I testicular cancer and decided to forgo adjuvant therapy. After 8 months of follow-up, he was admitted to our department because of brain, lung, and spleen metastases. Since the serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) level was present at a high level at 1,297 ng/ml, he was given combination chemotherapy consisting of 3 cycles of PEB, cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin and one cycle of PE, cisplatin and etoposide. Because of the decline in lung diffusing capacity, the administration of bleomycin was stopped in the final course. However, the AFP level remained above 14 ng/ml. Then he was given one more cycle of VIP therapy (etoposide, ifosfamide, cisplatin), but the serum AFP level was increased to 56 ng/ml. Then, two cycles of chemotherapy with paclitaxel, ifosfamide and cisplatin were administered as salvage chemotherapy, which led to a normalization of the serum AFP level, and disappearance of the brain and spleen metastases. Residual lung mass was resected at the surgical department, and microscopically no viable tumor cells remained. Three years after his final hospitalization, the patient has had no evidence of recurrence or metastasis.
abstract_ja: 30歳の男性が精巣がんと診断され、根治的精巣摘除術を受けた。病理診断は混合型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍であった。病期Iの精巣がんと診断し、補助療法は行わないことを決定した。8か月の経過観察後、脳、肺、脾臓への転移のため当科に入院した。血清αフェトプロテイン（AFP）値が1,297 ng/mlと高値であったため、PEB（シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン）3コースとPE（シスプラチン、エトポシド）1コースからなる併用化学療法を行った。肺拡散能の低下のため、最終コースではブレオマイシンの投与を中止した。しかし、AFP値は14 ng/mlを超えたままであった。その後、もう1コースのVIP療法（エトポシド、イホスファミド、シスプラチン）を施行したが、血清AFP値は56 ng/mlに上昇した。そこで救援化学療法として、パクリタキセル、イホスファミド、シスプラチンによる2コースの化学療法を行ったところ、血清AFP値は正常化し、脳および脾臓の転移は消失した。残存肺腫瘤は外科で切除され、組織学的に生存腫瘍細胞は認められなかった。最終入院から3年後も、患者に再発や転移の証拠はない。
